text:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked from stage -> canary. CI cache restore failed when fetching artifact (504). Affected pipeline: release/2026-03-23. Logs attached.

alex: ack, saw the alert. Can someone repro locally? can we fetch from the mirror?

sasha: repro'd. cache service returning 504 from eu-west mirror intermittently. Re-fetch sometimes succeeds.

lee: if it's flaky we could pin to last-good artifact digest to unblock the change window. That avoids re-running cache restore.

emily: heads up — our CI also validates release-notes label on the PR. promotion won't go through until that's present.

paul: options: 1) pin to sha:abc123 (last good) + manual promote, 2) rerun cache restore until it succeeds. Which is faster for the 20:00 UTC change window?

alex: change window 20:00 UTC in ~2h. I'd prefer pin+manual promote so we don't risk multiple retry flaps.

sasha: pin needs a deploybot override — @triage-bot can you open a manual-promote request for release/2026-03-23? include smoke requirement.

triage-bot: Manual promote request created by alex for release/2026-03-23. Approver group: #release-leads. Reason: cache-restore-504.

maria: oncall release lead here — OK to manual promote if preflight smoke passes and release notes are updated. I'll approve after smoke result.

lee: triggering smoke now: 
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --target canary --timeout 300
# job started: smoke-8421
```

deploy-bot: Canary preflight smoke job smoke-8421 started by lee. Running tests: healthcheck, basic inference, routing.

deploy-bot: Smoke job smoke-8421 completed: PASSED (12/12 checks). Duration 2m18s.

paul: pinning artifact and scheduling manual promote. pinned image: registry.redwood.io/release/2026-03-23@sha256:abc123

deploy-bot: Artifact pinned to sha256:abc123. Manual promote queued. Scheduled promote at 20:30 UTC per change window.

alex: I'll patch the release PR with release-notes and add label `release-notes/ready`.

emily: thanks. Please add short note about the cache 504 and the temporary pin workaround.

paul: rollback plan documented: if canary detects regressions we revert to sha256:def456 and open rollback channel.

sasha: opened ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1023 to track cache-restore 504 and mirror errors. added logs and timestamps.

alex: thanks everyone. tagging release notes and will follow up with post-mortem if INF-1023 shows systemic issue. :thumbsup:
